info.name: Student Awards - API tests (COMP 3613 A2)
info.description:
Automated API tests for the Student Awards app.

**Before every run:** `python manage.py init` (drops + reseeds the DB) then `python manage.py run`.
**Run:** Collection Runner (keep 'Save cookies' on) or
`newman run postman/student-awards.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json`.

Requests run in order: later folders depend on state created by earlier ones (login cookies, pending entries, redemption ids). Redirects are NOT followed so the 303 responses and Location headers can be asserted.
